text.p: Rent-Way Inc said on Monday that it completed the acquisition of the rental merchandise and rental agreements of R.A. Wolford Inc for roughly $2.8 million.
"With these new stores, Rent-Way's revenue stream will increase to a running rate of $8.5 million monthly, or approximately $102 million annually," said Rent-Way president William Morgenstern.
R.A. Wolford, a privately-owned four store rental-purchase chain, has annual revenues of about $3.3 million, Rent-Way added in a statement.
The Rent-Way rental purchase chain has acquired 89 stores, merged eight stores in overlapping markets, and sold five stores in fiscal 1997, Rent-Way said.
